name: ai-trader
tagline_zh: 别人晒收益，你晒信号源。AI-Trader 让交易信号一键发布，跟单不迷路，抄作业也有尊严。
tagline_en: Stop chasing gains, start sharing signals. AI-Trader lets you publish and follow trades with zero fluff.
desc_en: AI-Trader - AI Trading Signal Platform. Publish trading signals, follow traders. Use when user mentions trading signals, copy trading, stock trading, or follow traders.
why_zh: 同类工具只给信号，它把发布和跟单闭环打通，且信号可溯源，抄作业抄得明明白白。
why_en: Unlike signal-only tools, it closes the loop from publish to follow, with traceable signals for transparent copy trading.
